object.name: evi.backverb~
object.digest: Ursa Major reverb unit with saturating feedback
object.description: A strange reverb-like effect, based on Christopher Moore's legendary 1978 Ursa Major Space Station algorithm. This is not an attempt to model the 1970's digital hardware, but more of a trope on it, although it does sound very close to the original with the right settings. Nonlinearities and trap filters have been added, much as you might find in an analog delay, as well as different modulation, interpolation, smoothing and filtering modifications. Also cheap on CPU.

attributes.name: drywet
attributes.description: Dry/Wet mix of direct signal and reverberated signal. Dry is 0, completely wet is 1.

attributes.name: feedback
attributes.description: Linear amplitude, but does not act like it. Think of this as the amount of feedback potential in the system, depending on other attributes.

attributes.name: feedbackdamphigh
attributes.description: The high damping amount of the post feedback trap filters at the Hz point of 'feedbackhzhigh'. The higher the values the more damping takes place, the lower the values the more feedback will recirculate.

attributes.name: feedbackdamplow
attributes.description: The low damping amount of the post feedback trap filters at the Hz point of 'feedbackhzlow'. The higher the values the more damping takes place, the lower the values the more feedback will recirculate.

attributes.name: feedbackhzhigh
attributes.description: The high feedback attenuation point in Hz of the post feedback trap filters.

attributes.name: feedbackhzlow
attributes.description: The low feedback attenuation point in Hz of the post feedback trap filters.

attributes.name: feedbacknonlinear
attributes.description: The nonlinearity in the feedback path of the reverb. 0=Adaa2 (2nd order antiderivative anti-aliasing) tanh-like saturation, 1=same but 2x oversampled, 2=same but 4x oversampled.

attributes.name: inputhzhigh
attributes.description: Lowpass the audio input at specified Hz

attributes.name: inputhzlow
attributes.description: Highpass the audio input at specified Hz

attributes.name: modulationdepth
attributes.description: The closer to zero this value is, the more feedback recirculation will be allowed to occur. The higher the values the more movement in the sound. This can be a really useful parameter to be in control of feedback surges.

attributes.name: modulationduty
attributes.description: The duty of the triangle portion of the modulation LFO (if selected).

attributes.name: modulationrate
attributes.description: The slower the rate (lower values) the more the feedback can build, the higher the rate the more in control the feedback can be kept.

attributes.name: modulationshape
attributes.description: Morph modulation LFO between triangle..sine shapes 0..1.

attributes.name: modulationskew
attributes.description: Exponentially skew the modulation LFO shape.

attributes.name: outputnonlinear
attributes.description: The parabolic nonlinearity shape at the end of the reverb chain. 0=naive (not recommended as can alias), 1=same but 2x oversampled, 2=same but 4x oversampled.
